worldcombat.skill.victorydance.summary: A rite that calls victory: the user salutes, stamps each beat into the ground and raises a laurel crown on the last one, boosting Attack, Defence and Speed. The crown lasts for a visible window, but every hit landed while it is up extends it; when it finally ends, the three stats it raised are taken back.
worldcombat.skill.victorydance.use.0: Raise Attack, Defence and Speed before the fight is decided
worldcombat.skill.victorydance.use.1: Hold the rite while the foe is low and let hits keep the victory alive
worldcombat.skill.victorydance.use.2: Plant your feet and show your colours with the grandest dance
worldcombat.skill.victorydance.descripti: After the wind-up Attack, Defence and Speed each rise by %1$s and %2$s beats are stamped; the rite raises about %3$s laurels.
The crown lasts %1$s with a radius of %2$s blocks; when it ends those three stats are taken back.
worldcombat.skill.victorydance.rally: While the crown lasts, every enemy the dancer hits extends the window by %1$s, up to %2$s; past the cap it stops growing.
worldcombat.skill.victorydance.grand.on: Grand: two more beats and the crown window multiplied by 1.4, at the cost of a 4-tick longer wind-up and 20 ticks more cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.victorydance.grand.off: Plain: the regular beat count and window, quicker to finish.
worldcombat.skill.victorydance.timing: A self move with %1$s blocks of range; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.victorydance.growth.0: At level %1$s the crown window stretches to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.victorydance.growth.1: At level %1$s the crown window stretches further to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.victorydance.preferenc: On: two more beats and the crown window multiplied by 1.4, at the cost of a 4-tick longer wind-up and 20 ticks more cooldown. Off: plain, quicker to finish.
The rite is considered only against a threat within this distance; larger means raising the crown earlier.
A threat closer than this makes the companion attack instead of dancing; larger gives up the buff more often up close.
